description: Use when you need a bounded Base token assessment with explicit unassessed areas. Token safety check for Base tokens and contracts before further review. Basic: dated deployed-bytecode and OFAC SDN address-match signals from bounded public-chain reads. Deep adds standard owner(), paused(), totalSupply(), decimals() and ERC-1967 storage observations, exact ERC-1167 minimal-proxy target detection, a Sourcify runtime-verification claim matched to current bytecode, and direct-deployment age when independently supported by the creation receipt. Assessment stays incomplete: honeypot/sellability, full mint/blacklist powers, liquidity locks, holder concentration and non-OFAC scam lists are NOT assessed. Missing data is unknown; never a safe-to-buy verdict or full audit. Informational, not financial advice. Basic 0.02 USDC; deep 0.05 USDC. Shared trial first. Example arguments: {"address":"0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913","chain":"eip155:8453","tier":"basic"}. Example only; no safety endorsement. Price: 0.02 basic; 0.05 deep USDC. Minimal input example: {"address":"0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913","chain":"eip155:8453","tier":"basic"}. Illustrative output excerpt: {"verdict":"unknown","assessment_complete":false,"unassessed":["honeypot_and_sellability","mint_and_blacklist_privileges","liquidity_lock_or_removability","holder_concentration","non_OFAC_scam_lists","complete_owner_privilege_and_proxy_analysis"]}. Illustrative output excerpt, not a live result, signature, approval or guarantee. Freshness/data/availability checks still apply. How to pay (MCP): First use the existing shared allowance of 3 eligible calls per IP per UTC day, without payment metadata. This is shared with eligible HTTP trials, not a new allowance. Use an x402-capable MCP client. A generic MCP connector without payment support cannot complete a paid continuation. On payment required, STOP. Inspect the exact accepts amount, asset, network and payTo; obtain explicit wallet/budget approval before continuing. Only after approval, let the configured x402 MCP client attach its signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] and retry the same tools/call arguments. Never send a separate USDC transfer or paste keys into tool arguments. Never silently fall back from free access to payment. If a signed attempt has an unknown outcome, inspect that authorization/transaction; do not create another automatically.

address.description: Required. 0x-prefixed 20-byte Base token or contract address string. Example: 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913. An example address is not a safety endorsement.

chain.description: Optional. CAIP-2 chain identifier string; only Base eip155:8453 is supported. Example: eip155:8453. Defaults to Base when omitted.

tier.description: Optional. Assessment tier enum string: basic or deep. Example: basic. Defaults to basic; existing prices and incomplete-assessment limits apply.
